Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect

The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 13.36.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect

The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 58.87.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect

Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect

Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 23.85.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct

The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 1.14.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect

Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect

The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 9.14.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect

font-weight: bold;">&chi;<sup>2</sup> = 4.667</td></tr></tfoot></table><p>You roll a six-sided die 72 times. The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 4.67.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect

Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect

The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 4.38.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect

The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 10.00.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect

Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect

The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 39.58.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect

Correct	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect

The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 102.08.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect

Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 16.73.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect

Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect

Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect

Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect

font-weight: bold;">&chi;<sup>2</sup> = 8.000</td></tr></tfoot></table><p>You roll a six-sided die 60 times. The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 8.00.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect

Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 11.20.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct

The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 4.44.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect

Correct	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6. The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is that each face has probability 1/6 on every roll.</p><p>Subtract expected from observed, square the difference, and divide by expected. Add the six contributions to get &chi;<sup>2</sup>. The total uses unrounded contributions.</p><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><caption style="text-align: left; font-weight: bold; padding: 6px; color: #606060; background: #efefef; border-top: 2px solid #606060;">Chi-square critical values (probability in the right tail)</caption><thead><tr style="background: #efefef; color: #606060;"><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">Degrees of freedom</th><th scope="col" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: center;">0.05</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">4</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">9.49</td></tr><tr style="background: #f2f5f7;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">5</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">11.07</td></tr><tr style="background: #ffffff;"><th scope="row" style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right; text-align: left; font-weight: normal;">6</th><td style="padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b8b8b8; text-align: right;">12.59</td></tr></tbody></table><p>Calculated &chi;<sup>2</sup> = 5.18.</p><p>Which one of the following conclusions is supported at &alpha; = 0.05?</p>	Reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Incorrect	Fail to reject the null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>); there is not enough evidence that face probabilities differ from 1/6.	Correct	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is proven; every face has exactly the same chance on each roll.	Incorrect	The null hypothesis (H<sub>0</sub>) is disproven; a fair die must give exactly equal counts of all faces.	Incorrect
